login.email: An email - only use this if you want to run a self-botted instance; For bots use the above token

stoat.js.Comment: Configuration data for revolt.js clients; See possible options here: https://revolt.js.org/classes/Client.html#constructor

comment-radio.message: If you have radio stations you'd like to connect, add them to the array below. Radio stations must be rendered like following:

station.name: zamrock
station.url: url to stream from; this will be kept private

dashboardUrl: The url the dashboard is accessible with.

stoat-api.Comment: Configuration options for a revolt-api client; See the last example here: https://github.com/insertish/oapi#example

owners: not necessary unless you want to use testing commands
Comment: The above specifies the time in ms after which a player goes inactive; Optional
